headline: Customers Report Widespread Service Outages At Major American Banks
seoTitle: Major US Banks Report Service Outages
metaDescription: Customers at JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo reported significant difficulties accessing online accounts and payment services today.
aiSummaryBullets: Users at major financial institutions including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo reported issues with online account access.
The disruption also affected the Zelle payment service, according to user complaints.
Thousands of reports were logged across the affected platforms during the period of service interruption.
aiContextParagraph: On November 16, 2026, customers across the United States experienced widespread technical difficulties preventing access to online banking services at several major financial institutions. Primary reports indicated that JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo were among those impacted, alongside the Zelle payment network. Data from user feedback indicated that Bank of America received approximately 2,000 complaints, while JPMorgan Chase faced nearly 5,000 reports of service issues. These connectivity disruptions occurred following a recent outage involving Microsoft 365 services that took place the previous week. While the banking sector has faced increased scrutiny regarding digital infrastructure reliability, these specific reports highlight concerns regarding the stability of online retail banking platforms. Financial institutions have not yet detailed the technical causes of the current service interruptions, which have disrupted account management and digital transaction capabilities for thousands of individual banking customers.
whyItIsViral: The event is viral due to coverage by three independent news outlets and a high velocity of reporting across international media sources.
